    - Reviews: Friendly staff, clean and reliable cars, great location near the Eiffel Tower

- Hotel (Le Marais Boutique): 3 days at €120.00 per day = €360.00
- Car Rental (Paris Rent-a-Car): 3 days at €45.00 per day = €135.00
- Meals (Miznon, most budget-friendly option): 2 meals per day at €15.00 per meal = €90.00
